# Xelorsoft

> Xelorsoft is a software company. It builds custom software, AI tools and business websites for growing businesses, and makes its own SaaS products: XS Gym, XS Salon, XS Connect and XS Arena. All copy and support are in English; the products also speak Malayalam.

## Products

- [XS Gym](https://xelorsoft.com/gym-management-software/): gym management software for members, memberships, payments, expenses, enquiries, WhatsApp reminders and an English/Malayalam voice assistant.
- [XS Salon](https://xelorsoft.com/salon-software/): salon software with a stylist calendar, GST billing, clients, services, inventory, reports and an online booking link.
- [XS Connect](https://xelorsoft.com/whatsapp-crm/): one inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook messages, with AI replies in English or Malayalam, leads and orders.
- [XS Arena](https://xelorsoft.com/game-centre-software/): software for snooker parlours, PS5 lounges and RC tracks: live floor, session timers, billing and expenses.

## Services

- [Custom software](https://xelorsoft.com/#services): web and mobile apps for one business workflow or a whole operation.
- [AI and automation](https://xelorsoft.com/#ai): assistants that handle repeat work such as replies, reminders and data entry.
- [Websites](https://xelorsoft.com/#web): fast business websites with contact forms, email and search listing set up.
